name: Swami Vivekananda Merit-cum-Means (SVMCM)
nodal_agency: Higher Education Department, Govt. of West Bengal

eligibility.income_note: No income limit for Board Toppers, Kanyashree (K3), or M.Phil/Ph.D applicants

tiers.benefit_text: ₹1,000/month (HS & D.El.Ed)
₹1,500/month (Polytechnic / Medical Diploma)
₹1,000/month
₹1,500/month
₹5,000/month
₹2,000/month (45% marks for Kanyashree K3 girls)
₹2,500/month (45% marks for Kanyashree K3 girls)
₹5,000/month
₹5,000/mo (Non-NET M.Phil) / ₹8,000/mo (Non-NET Ph.D)

exclusivity_note: Cannot avail any other Central or State Government scholarship/stipend for the same course. One-time grants or institutional freeships are allowed.

Active bank passbook (student's own name, DBT-enabled)
deadline: Check portal for 2026-27 cycle (Failed transaction correction by 30 June)

name: WB Kanyaratna Education Grant (formerly Kanyashree Prakalpa)
nodal_agency: Dept. of Women & Child Development and Social Welfare, WB

eligibility.income_note: No family income limit (₹1.2L ceiling was withdrawn from 2018-19)

tiers.benefit_text: K1: ₹1,000/yr (increasing to ₹2,000/yr from 2027) for age 13–18
K1: ₹1,000/yr (₹2,000/yr from 2027) for unmarried girls aged 13–18
K1 Annual + K2 One-time ₹25,000 at age 18–19 (doubling to ₹50,000 from 2027)
K2 One-time ₹25,000 at age 18–19 (doubling to ₹50,000 from 2027)

exclusivity_note: Girls securing 60%+ in Class 12 may also apply separately for SVMCM.
documents: Bank account details of the girl applicant
Prescribed Kanyaratna application form from institution

SC/ST: ₹7,000–₹13,500/yr | OBC ITI/Vocational: ₹5,000/yr
SC/ST: Up to ₹13,500/yr | OBC: Up to ₹20,000/yr
Post-Matric SC/ST/OBC rates as per course group

Post-Matric / Minority SVMCM eligible courses

name: Nabanna / Uttar Kanya Scholarship (CMRF Education Assistance)
nodal_agency: Chief Minister's Relief Fund (CMRF), Govt. of WB

eligibility.income_note: Annual family income must not exceed ₹1,20,000

tiers.benefit_text: Commonly ₹10,000/yr (For students scoring 50% to <60% in Madhyamik)
Commonly ₹10,000/yr (For students scoring 50% to <60% in HS)
Commonly ₹10,000/yr (For students scoring 50% to <53% in Graduation)

exclusivity_note: Must NOT be receiving any Government or Non-Government scholarship/stipend for the same course.
documents: Signed application addressed to the Hon'ble Chief Minister
Self-declaration countersigned with stamp/seal by Head of Institution
Admission receipt & Bank passbook first page (PDFs < 500 KB)
Entrance Rank Card & Allotment Letter (for professional courses)
apply_mode: Online via WB CMRF Portal (submit within 90 days of registration)
deadline: Open year-round (Can register once every 365 days)

name: West Bengal Shikshashree Scheme
nodal_agency: Backward Classes Welfare & Tribal Development Dept., WB

tiers.benefit_text: ₹750/yr (SC Class 5–7) | ₹800/yr (SC Class 8 & ST Class 5–8)

exclusivity_note: Must be enrolled in a Govt, Govt-aided, or Govt-recognised school in WB.

name: West Bengal SARATHI Scheme (formerly Sabooj Sathi)
nodal_agency: WB SC, ST, OBC Development & Finance Corporation

tiers.benefit_text: Free Bicycle for Class IX students (extending to Class VIII from 2027-28)

exclusivity_note: Must not have already received a bicycle under the scheme.
documents: Proof of admission in Class IX
School ID / Banglar Shiksha Student Registration
apply_mode: Automatic through School (Banglar Shiksha / SARATHI Portal — no separate student form)
deadline: Managed by school during Academic Year 2026-27

name: West Bengal Taruner Swapna Scheme
nodal_agency: School Education Department, Govt. of WB

eligibility.income_note: Annual family income must not exceed ₹2,00,000

tiers.benefit_text: ₹10,000 one-time grant to buy Smartphone, Tablet, or PC
₹10,000 one-time grant for ITI / Polytechnic students

exclusivity_note: One-time grant. Must have no backlogs and must submit the purchase bill to the school.
documents: Banglar Shiksha Student Code & School ID
apply_mode: Online via Taruner Swapna Portal (OTP verification)
deadline: 2026 Academic Session (Currently open — verify via school)

name: West Bengal Bhagini Nivedita Scheme
nodal_agency: Govt. of West Bengal (Cabinet approved Oct 2026)

eligibility.income_note: Detailed income/marks guidelines awaited from Govt. of WB

tiers.benefit_text: ₹50,000 over 3 years (₹17,000 Yr 1 + ₹17,000 Yr 2 + ₹16,000 Yr 3) in Govt/Govt-aided colleges

exclusivity_note: Cannot be combined with SVMS UG benefit; awaiting full official notification.
documents: Proof of 1st-year UG admission in Govt/Govt-aided college

name: JBNSTS Senior Talent Search / Bigyani Kanya Medha Britti
nodal_agency: Jagadis Bose National Science Talent Search (JBNSTS)

eligibility.income_note: No income limit (Pure merit via exam; Bigyani Kanya track is for girls only)

tiers.benefit_text: Monthly stipend + book grant (Must pass 10+2 in 2026; B.Sc Hons / BS-MS / Engg / Med in WB; ₹200 exam fee)

exclusivity_note: B.Sc Pass, Diploma, and B.Sc Nursing students are NOT eligible. Proof of 1st-year UG admission required by Dec 2026.
documents: Valid personal Email ID & Mobile Number (OTP)
Proof of 1st-year UG admission (submitted in Dec 2026)
deadline: Admission proof submission by December 2026 (Check portal for exam dates)

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship (Specially-Abled Students)

eligibility.income_note: Annual family income ≤ ₹8,00,000 (State/UT Govt issued certificate)

tiers.benefit_text: ₹50,000/year lump sum (Max 4 yrs for 1st-yr entry, 3 yrs for 2nd-yr lateral entry in AICTE-approved institutes)

exclusivity_note: Cannot receive any other scholarship, stipend, or financial assistance from any other source; violation requires full refund to AICTE. Max 2-year gap after qualifying exam.

name: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarship

tiers.benefit_text: Up to ₹2,00,000 total over degree duration (Any regular full-time 3+ yr UG stream; mandatory 60-min online Aptitude Test)

exclusivity_note: Excludes 2nd-year+ students, distance/online degrees, 2-yr/6-yr UG degrees, and post-10th diploma holders.
documents: Bank Passbook / Cancelled Cheque (in student's own name)
Proof of permanent address & Passport photo
apply_mode: Online + Mandatory 60-min Online Aptitude Test (No fee)
deadline: 2026-27 cycle closed Oct 5, 2026 (Next cycle opens Aug–Oct 2027)
